Name: trailer__The_Reality_Machine
Behaviour: Opens character -> reality -> experience selection. The heart of the game.
RepeatBehaviour: Hums differently depending on how many realities you have unlocked.

Name: trailer__Artifact_Pedestal_A
Behaviour: Displays one artifact; visitors can examine it.

Name: trailer__Artifact_Pedestal_B
Behaviour: Second display slot.

Name: trailer__Artifact_Pedestal_C
Behaviour: Third display slot.

Name: trailer__Weapon_Wall
Behaviour: Mounts up to six weapons. Lobby-only weapons still fire in here (GDD 4).

Name: trailer__Workbench
Behaviour: Crafting and weapon upgrades (Part II 37).

Name: trailer__Wardrobe
Behaviour: Character creator access without re-entering the Machine.

Name: trailer__The_Fridge
Behaviour: Ordinary fridge. Ordinary food.
Secret: After the first reality is completed, it opens onto a corridor instead.

Name: trailer__Trophy_Shelf
Behaviour: Minigame trophies and event rewards.

Name: trailer__The_Radio
Behaviour: Plays reality-specific stations.
Secret: One station is broadcasting from inside whatever reality you visited last.

Name: trailer__Pet_Bed
Behaviour: Where an adopted companion lives (Part II 42). Visitors can pet it.

Name: trailer__Guest_Book
Behaviour: Every visitor who enters your trailer can leave one line.

Name: trailer__The_Window
Behaviour: Shows your own sky.
Secret: Occasionally shows a sky you have not visited yet.

Name: trailer__Vehicle_Pad
Behaviour: Outside the door. Displays one owned vehicle (Part II 43).

Name: portal_hub__Portal_P1___Crystalline
Behaviour: Gateway to the shattered-crystal world. Tag strip shows biome, hazard, activity.

Name: portal_hub__Portal_P2___Bio_Metropolis
Behaviour: Gateway to the grown city.

Name: portal_hub__Portal_P3___Plasma_Strait
Behaviour: Gateway to the storm and the wreck fields.

Name: portal_hub__Portal_P4___Ruins_Labyrinth
Behaviour: Gateway to the overgrown maze.

Name: portal_hub__Portal_P5___Gravity_Ring
Behaviour: Gateway to the ringed world.

Name: portal_hub__The_CORE
Behaviour: The hub's power source and its central mystery. Anchor for the three-key hunt.
Secret: Accepts three keys found across three different realities.

Name: portal_hub__Tag_Reader
Behaviour: Explains what a portal's icon strip means before you commit.

Name: portal_hub__The_Noticeboard
Behaviour: Player-left notes about what is through each portal.

Name: portal_hub__Bartering_Post
Behaviour: Opens the two-sided trade window with a nearby player (Part II 39).

Name: portal_hub__The_Vending_Machine
Behaviour: Dispenses an object from a reality you have not visited. Never the same twice.

Name: portal_hub__Minigame_Arch
Behaviour: Leads to the minigame portals (Part II 41).

Name: portal_hub__Vehicle_Rail
Behaviour: Spawns your stored vehicle for hub traversal.

Name: portal_hub__The_Bench_of_Agreement
Behaviour: Two players sitting at once opens something under the gantry.

Name: portal_hub__Broken_Portal_P0
Behaviour: Dead frame, no light.
Secret: Comes alive once, briefly, after the CORE is opened.

Name: living_city__The_Bust
Behaviour: A marble bust pours coffee. Nobody in the city finds this remarkable. +Stamina.
Secret: Every twentieth cup is not coffee.
RepeatBehaviour: At night it pours something that glows.

Name: living_city__The_Complaining_Door
Behaviour: Locked, and it explains at length exactly why, and whose fault it is.
RepeatBehaviour: Tell it you agree and it unlocks.

Name: living_city__Staircase_to_Nowhere
Behaviour: Ends in open air two storeys up.
Secret: Keep walking upward anyway and the next step appears.

Name: living_city__The_Payphone
Behaviour: Rings whenever a player walks past. Someone is on the line and knows your name.

Name: living_city__The_Puddle
Behaviour: Reflects a version of this street that is on fire. Yours is not.

Name: living_city__The_Chair_That_Waits
Behaviour: Moves a little closer whenever no player is looking at it.

Name: living_city__The_Mailbox
Behaviour: Holds a note another player left in this reality.

Name: living_city__The_Loud_Painting
Behaviour: Plays music, audible only within two metres of it.

Name: living_city__The_Chandelier
Behaviour: Swings to point at the nearest player.
Secret: After dark it points at something else entirely.

Name: living_city__The_Bureaucrat_s_Desk
Behaviour: Stamping the form moves a wall somewhere else in the district.

Name: living_city__The_Elevator
Behaviour: Six buttons. Four go to floors.
Secret: The fifth goes to a floor that is not in this building.

Name: living_city__The_Telescope
Behaviour: Shows other realities.
RepeatBehaviour: Once in a while it shows this street, from behind you.

Name: living_city__Building_That_Breathes
Behaviour: The facade expands and contracts. Warm to the touch.

Name: living_city__The_Suggestion_Box
Behaviour: Whatever you write shows up somewhere in the city later.

Name: living_city__Traffic_Light_Choir
Behaviour: Three lights, singing in harmony. They change key when a car passes.

Name: living_city__The_Fountain
Behaviour: Give it an item, get a different one back. Rarity is roughly preserved.

Name: living_city__Reality_Weapon_Cache
Behaviour: Contains the Gravity Gun (Reality class) behind a two-player lock.

Name: living_city__The_Eye_of_Reality
Behaviour: Legendary artifact. Origin: Reality 07. Status: unknown.
Secret: Only appears once the city has rearranged itself three times.

Name: the_deep__The_Lantern_Shoal
Behaviour: A shoal of lights that leads somewhere if you keep up. It does not wait.

Name: the_deep__Pressure_Door
Behaviour: Takes two players turning opposite wheels at once.

Name: the_deep__The_Singing_Coral
Behaviour: Each branch is a note. Play the right five and something opens below.
Secret: The sequence is written on the ceiling of the sunken hall.

Name: the_deep__Air_Pocket_Chapel
Behaviour: A dry room at the bottom of the sea. Someone has been living here.

Name: the_deep__The_Anchor
Behaviour: Attached to something that is not a boat.

Name: the_deep__Message_Bottles
Behaviour: Notes from players who drowned here.

Name: the_deep__Bioluminescent_Switchboard
Behaviour: Rerouting the light changes which corridors are safe.

Name: the_deep__The_Whale_Skeleton
Behaviour: Something is nesting in it. It is friendly, mostly.

Name: the_deep__Tide_Organ
Behaviour: The current plays it. You can change the tuning and the current follows.

Name: the_deep__Sunken_Vending_Machine
Behaviour: Still works. Still takes Credits. Dispenses dry snacks.

Name: the_deep__The_Drowned_Museum
Behaviour: Somebody else's trophy room, flooded. Their artifacts are still on the pedestals.
Secret: One pedestal is empty and labelled with your character's name.

Name: the_deep__Organic_Weapon_Pod
Behaviour: Contains the Living Blade (Organic class).

Name: the_deep__The_Depth_Marker
Behaviour: Counts down as you descend. Below zero it keeps counting.

Name: the_garden__The_Greeting_Vine
Behaviour: Shakes your hand. Remembers you next visit.
RepeatBehaviour: On the third visit it introduces you to another plant.

Name: the_garden__Seed_Bank
Behaviour: Plant a seed here and it grows into something over real-world days.

Name: the_garden__The_Carnivore
Behaviour: Feed it the wrong thing and it sulks for a week.

Name: the_garden__Pollen_Bell
Behaviour: Calls every creature within range. Some of them are pleased about it.

Name: the_garden__The_Compost_Heap
Behaviour: Bury an item, come back later, get something stranger.
Secret: Bury an artifact and the Garden makes an opinion known.

Name: the_garden__Walking_Tree
Behaviour: It is going somewhere. It has been going there for a long time.

Name: the_garden__The_Beehive_Archive
Behaviour: The hum is a recording. Of what, is the question.

Name: the_garden__Mushroom_Trampoline
Behaviour: Launches you into the canopy. The canopy has its own map.

Name: the_garden__The_Gardener_s_Shed
Behaviour: Tools, notes, and a schedule for something that is not gardening.

Name: the_garden__Sap_Still
Behaviour: Brews Healing and Hype potions from harvested sap (Part II 36).

Name: the_garden__The_Quiet_Clearing
Behaviour: Nothing happens until you stop moving for thirty seconds.

Name: the_garden__Plant_Whip_Bloom
Behaviour: Yields the Plant Whip (Organic class).

Name: the_garden__The_Cat
Behaviour: Not a pet. Leads patient players somewhere worth going.

Name: the_void__The_Handhold
Behaviour: The only fixed point. Let go and you drift.

Name: the_void__Gravity_Well_Switch
Behaviour: Reverses which way is down for everyone in the region.

Name: the_void__The_Long_Rope
Behaviour: Tied at one end. The other end is not visible.

Name: the_void__Starlight_Forge
Behaviour: Upgrades Cosmic weapons. Consumes Shards.

Name: the_void__The_Slow_Clock
Behaviour: Time near it runs at a third speed. Useful in a fight, awkward in a conversation.

Name: the_void__Debris_of_a_Trailer
Behaviour: Someone else's home, in pieces.
Secret: Their guest book survived. Your name is in it.

Name: the_void__The_Echo
Behaviour: Repeats what you said, correctly, in a voice that is not yours.

Name: the_void__Star_Cannon_Cradle
Behaviour: Yields the Star Cannon (Cosmic class).

Name: the_void__The_Tether_Ring
Behaviour: Two players tethered can reach islands neither could alone.

Name: the_void__Black_Marble
Behaviour: Weighs more than the island it is sitting on.

Name: the_void__The_Silent_Bell
Behaviour: No sound. Everyone in the reality feels it.

Name: the_void__Time_Shard_Rift
Behaviour: Yields the Time Shard (Reality class). Costs something.

Name: thought_world__The_First_Door
Behaviour: Leads wherever you were expecting it to lead.

Name: thought_world__Mirror_of_Habits
Behaviour: Shows how you have been playing. Not always flatteringly.

Name: thought_world__The_Path_That_Forms
Behaviour: Ground appears one step ahead. Stop and it stops.

Name: thought_world__Room_of_Loud_Thinking
Behaviour: Your proximity voice is broadcast to the whole reality while inside.

Name: thought_world__The_Contradiction
Behaviour: A staircase going up and down at once. Both are true.

Name: thought_world__Certainty_Meter
Behaviour: Measures how sure you are. Reacts to hesitation in your movement.

Name: thought_world__The_Agreeable_Wall
Behaviour: Moves if two players push it. Refuses to move for one.

Name: thought_world__Memory_Pedestal
Behaviour: Puts an artifact's origin story into the sky for everyone to read.

Name: thought_world__The_Quiet_Question
Behaviour: Asks one thing. Remembers the answer across sessions.
Secret: Answer the same way three visits running and it opens.

Name: thought_world__Mind_Trip_Still
Behaviour: Produces the Mind Trip potion. The world gets noticeably more honest.

Name: thought_world__The_Crowd
Behaviour: Figures that copy whatever the most players are doing.

Name: the_dreaming__Freestanding_Doors
Behaviour: Eighteen doors standing in open ground. Each leads to a different one of the others.
RepeatBehaviour: The pairing reshuffles every time the reality reloads.

Name: the_dreaming__The_Bed_in_the_Field
Behaviour: Sleeping here moves you to a different part of the reality. You do not choose which.

Name: the_dreaming__Upside_Down_Rain
Behaviour: Falls upward. Soaks you anyway.

Name: the_dreaming__The_Teacher
Behaviour: Asks about an exam you have not studied for. Will not be reasoned with.

Name: the_dreaming__Melting_Staircase
Behaviour: Softens under weight. Two players are too many.

Name: the_dreaming__The_Phone_That_Rings_Backwards
Behaviour: You speak first, then it rings.

Name: the_dreaming__Familiar_Room
Behaviour: It is your trailer, wrong in three details.
Secret: Finding all three details unlocks a trailer decor set.

Name: the_dreaming__The_Long_Corridor
Behaviour: Gets longer the faster you run down it.

Name: the_dreaming__Mask_Rack
Behaviour: Wearing one changes how NPCs across the reality address you.

Name: the_dreaming__The_Waking_Bell
Behaviour: Ejects you home immediately, gently. The only polite exit in the multiverse.

Name: the_wasteland__The_Last_Radio_Tower
Behaviour: Broadcasts a loop. The loop has a gap in it, and the gap is a message.

Name: the_wasteland__Fuel_Cache
Behaviour: Vehicle fuel. Guarded by something that was not always hostile.

Name: the_wasteland__Scrap_Press
Behaviour: Turns junk into crafting materials (Part II 37).

Name: the_wasteland__The_Bunker_Door
Behaviour: Needs two hands on two wheels twelve metres apart.

Name: the_wasteland__Family_Photo
Behaviour: An artifact worth nothing and everything.

Name: the_wasteland__Rust_Choir
Behaviour: Wind through wrecks. It is playing a song someone wrote.

Name: the_wasteland__The_Trading_Post
Behaviour: Player bartering hub for this reality (Part II 39).

Name: the_wasteland__Nano_Drone_Wreck
Behaviour: Yields the Nano Drone (Technology class).

Name: the_wasteland__The_Rift
Behaviour: World event anchor: defeat the Rift Guardian, collect 5 Energy Cores.

Name: the_wasteland__Boneyard_Sign
Behaviour: Names every player who died in this reality this week.

Name: the_wasteland__Working_Streetlight
Behaviour: The only one still lit for a hundred kilometres. Full health regen.

Name: pet_sanctuary__The_Runed_Doorway
Behaviour: The carved arch into the cottage. Warm light, a fire going.

Name: pet_sanctuary__The_Fireplace
Behaviour: Sitting here with another player starts a slow conversation prompt.

Name: pet_sanctuary__Sleeping_Cat
Behaviour: Adoptable. Will judge your trailer decor.

Name: pet_sanctuary__The_Golden_Dog
Behaviour: Adoptable. Brings back things it should not have found.

Name: pet_sanctuary__Rabbit_Hollow
Behaviour: They come out if you stay still.

Name: pet_sanctuary__The_Adoption_Sign
Behaviour: Explains the companion system. One pet per trailer, more with expansions.

Name: pet_sanctuary__Feed_Bin
Behaviour: Feeding another player's pet raises both of your reputations.

Name: pet_sanctuary__The_Stream
Behaviour: Leads out of the sanctuary and does not come back.

Name: pet_sanctuary__Carved_Bench
Behaviour: Names carved into it. All of them are players who have been here.

Name: pet_sanctuary__The_Lantern_Path
Behaviour: Light every lantern on the path and something arrives at the cottage.
Secret: It only works at the sanctuary's dusk.

Name: pet_sanctuary__Companion_Drone_Nest
Behaviour: Where the shoulder drone from the portal-network art is met.

Name: bio_metropolis__The_World_Tree_Lift
Behaviour: A living lift. It asks where you are going and sometimes disagrees.

Name: bio_metropolis__Root_Market
Behaviour: Shop stalls grown into the roots (Part II 38).

Name: bio_metropolis__Grafting_Bench
Behaviour: Combines two Organic weapons into one. Results are not always predictable.

Name: bio_metropolis__The_Pollen_Tram
Behaviour: Traverses the canopy on a schedule the city sets, not you.

Name: bio_metropolis__Hive_Council
Behaviour: NPC faction. They remember every interaction (GDD 18).

Name: bio_metropolis__The_Wound
Behaviour: A cut in the world-tree. Healing it changes the district's layout.

Name: bio_metropolis__Sap_Vault
Behaviour: Rare crafting materials behind a puzzle of growth cycles.

Name: bio_metropolis__Seedpod_Elevator_Shaft
Behaviour: Drops you to the roots. Coming back up is a separate problem.

Name: bio_metropolis__The_Key_of_Roots
Behaviour: One of three keys the CORE accepts (Part II 47).
Secret: Only forms after the Wound is healed.

Name: bio_metropolis__Canopy_Bridge
Behaviour: Grows across as you walk, retracts behind you.

Name: plasma_strait__The_Storm_Anchor
Behaviour: Calms the lightning in a radius for ninety seconds. Everyone benefits.

Name: plasma_strait__Charged_Wreck
Behaviour: Safe to loot only once the charge is bled off.

Name: plasma_strait__Lightning_Harp
Behaviour: Strikes tune themselves to what you play. Risky and worth it.

Name: plasma_strait__Salvage_Crane
Behaviour: One player drives, one player spots.

Name: plasma_strait__The_Barometer
Behaviour: Predicts the next storm surge accurately. Nobody trusts it.

Name: plasma_strait__Sound_Cannon_Wreck
Behaviour: Yields the Sound Cannon (Absurd class).

Name: plasma_strait__Faraday_Chapel
Behaviour: The only guaranteed-safe structure. Fits four.

Name: plasma_strait__The_Strait_Crossing
Behaviour: Passable for eleven seconds after each surge.

Name: plasma_strait__The_Key_of_Storms
Behaviour: Second of the three CORE keys.
Secret: Must be taken during a surge, not between them.

Name: plasma_strait__Wreck_of_the_Ferry
Behaviour: Passenger manifest. Some of the names are player names.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__The_Threshold_Stone
Behaviour: Names everyone currently inside the maze.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__Moss_Map
Behaviour: The moss grows in the shape of the maze. It is out of date.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__Wall_That_Listens
Behaviour: Say the right word and it steps aside. The word is elsewhere in the maze.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__The_Torch_Line
Behaviour: Lit torches persist for other players for an hour.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__Offering_Bowl
Behaviour: Give up an item; the maze simplifies for you. Give up an artifact; it opens.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__The_Repeating_Room
Behaviour: The same room four times. One of them has an extra door.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__Buried_Bell
Behaviour: Ringing it resets the maze layout for everyone in it.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__Paint_Blaster_Cache
Behaviour: Yields the Paint Blaster (Art class). Paint marks walls permanently.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__The_Key_of_Stone
Behaviour: Third of the three CORE keys, at the maze's true centre.
Secret: The true centre is not the geometric centre.

Name: ruins_labyrinth__Exit_That_Moves
Behaviour: It is never where you left it.

Name: gravity_ring__Gravity_Dial
Behaviour: Sets local gravity between 0.1 and 2.0 for a whole ring segment.

Name: gravity_ring__The_Drop
Behaviour: Falls forever unless someone changes the dial while you are falling.

Name: gravity_ring__Anti_Grav_Boot_Locker
Behaviour: Anti-Grav Boots — also the Gravity Arena minigame reward (Part II 41).

Name: gravity_ring__Orbital_Tram
Behaviour: Circles the ring. Stops are on the outside of the ring.

Name: gravity_ring__The_Balance_Puzzle
Behaviour: Two players on two plates, different masses, one bridge.

Name: gravity_ring__Fallen_Climber
Behaviour: Their log describes a segment that is not on any map.

Name: gravity_ring__Gravity_Gun_Vault
Behaviour: Yields the Gravity Gun (Reality class).

Name: gravity_ring__The_Inverted_Town
Behaviour: Built on the underside. The residents consider you upside-down.

Name: gravity_ring__Ring_Fracture
Behaviour: A missing segment. Crossing it needs the dial and a running start.

Name: the_arcade__Racer_s_Edge_Cabinet
Behaviour: Minigame: Urban Velocity. Reward: 'Neon Rider' bike skin. Leaderboard on the marquee.

Name: the_arcade__Vortex_Cabinet
Behaviour: Minigame: our own 8-bit arena. Reward: Retro Artifact x1. All games original.

Name: the_arcade__Gravity_Arena_Cabinet
Behaviour: Minigame: Float Fights, zero-g combat. Reward: Anti-Grav Boots.

Name: the_arcade__Mystery_Vault_Cabinet
Behaviour: Minigame: Decryptor 7, a cipher puzzle. Reward: holographic trailer decor.

Name: the_arcade__Deathtrack_Cabinet
Behaviour: Minigame: Neon Deathtrack race variant. Reward: vehicle cosmetics.

Name: the_arcade__Crawl_Cabinet
Behaviour: Minigame: top-down co-op dungeon crawl. Reward: consumables and materials.

Name: the_arcade__The_High_Score_Board
Behaviour: Every minigame's top name and score, updated live.

Name: the_arcade__Token_Machine
Behaviour: Credits to event Tokens (Part II 38).

Name: the_arcade__The_Cabinet_Nobody_Plays
Behaviour: Unlabelled, unlit, in the corner.
Secret: Plays a game about a trailer and a machine. It knows your play history.

Name: the_arcade__Prize_Counter
Behaviour: Tickets for trailer decor and emotes.

Name: the_arcade__Two_Player_Cabinet
Behaviour: Refuses to start with one player. Best rewards in the street.

Name: the_arcade__Battle_Arena_Gate
Behaviour: The street's one PvP zone. Opt-in, nothing at stake but the leaderboard.

Name: crystal_shatter__The_Ringing_Floor
Behaviour: Each step is a note. Other players hear your route as music.

Name: crystal_shatter__Fracture_Line
Behaviour: Breaking it opens a path and closes another.

Name: crystal_shatter__The_Tuning_Shard
Behaviour: Held, it makes nearby crystal safe to touch.

Name: crystal_shatter__Prism_Lock
Behaviour: Three beams, three players, one door.

Name: crystal_shatter__The_Frozen_Explorer
Behaviour: An NPC caught mid-step. Freeing them is not obviously a good idea.

Name: crystal_shatter__Echo_Cavern
Behaviour: Repeats everything said in it for the next player who enters.

Name: crystal_shatter__Shard_Vein
Behaviour: The reality's Shard currency source (Part II 38).

Name: crystal_shatter__The_Unbroken_Pane
Behaviour: Shows the Portal Hub from the inside of P1. Someone is standing there.

Name: portal_glade__The_Standing_Portals
Behaviour: Six frames with nothing holding them up. Each one is lit a different colour.

Name: portal_glade__The_Campfire
Behaviour: The community panel's fire. Players sitting here hear each other clearly regardless of proximity falloff — the one place voice does not fade.

Name: portal_glade__The_Unlit_Frame
Behaviour: A seventh frame, dark.
Secret: Lights only when six different players have used the other six today.

Name: portal_glade__Trail_Markers
Behaviour: Stones stacked by players. Each stack names a reality and a warning.

Name: portal_glade__The_Old_Bench
Behaviour: Facing the portals. Worn smooth in two places.

Name: portal_glade__Moss_Clock
Behaviour: Tells the time in whichever reality you last visited.

Name: portal_glade__The_Returning_Path
Behaviour: Leads back to your trailer on foot. Takes four minutes. Worth doing once.

Name: portal_glade__Lantern_Tree
Behaviour: Hang a lantern to leave a message for whoever arrives next.

Name: portal_glade__The_Listening_Stone
Behaviour: Plays back the last thing said in this glade.
RepeatBehaviour: Occasionally plays something said here a very long time ago.

Name: the_cascades__The_Terrace
Behaviour: Parasols, tables, a view over the falls. Players idle here between runs.

Name: the_cascades__Waterfall_Curtain
Behaviour: There is a room behind it. There is a room behind three of the four.

Name: the_cascades__The_Ascending_Stones
Behaviour: Stepping stones up to the floating islands. They sink if you hesitate.

Name: the_cascades__Mist_Ruin
Behaviour: A building the mist keeps hiding. Its floor plan is not consistent.

Name: the_cascades__The_Parasol_That_Is_Not_One
DisplayName: The Parasol That Is Not One
Behaviour: Opens into a chute down to a lower valley.

Name: the_cascades__Secret_Portal
Behaviour: A portal in a world that is not a hub. Leads to one random reality.
Secret: It remembers where it sent you and never repeats until it has sent you everywhere.

Name: the_cascades__The_Island_Bell
Behaviour: Rings across the whole valley. Every player hears it and knows roughly where.

Name: the_cascades__Field_Notes
Behaviour: Someone catalogued this place. Their last entry is unfinished.

Name: the_cascades__The_Long_Rope_Bridge
Behaviour: Two players' weight makes it stable. One player's makes it swing.

Name: the_cascades__Creature_Nest
Behaviour: Not hostile. Curious. Follows you for a while and then does not.

Name: the_cascades__The_Overlook
Behaviour: The postcard shot. Emote here and it is worth extra reputation.

Name: the_bazaar__The_Trade_Ring
Behaviour: The bartering floor. Two-sided offers, both confirm (Part II 39).

Name: the_bazaar__Appraiser_s_Stall
Behaviour: Tells you what an artifact is actually worth. Charges for the opinion.

Name: the_bazaar__The_Fence
Behaviour: Buys anything, asks nothing, pays badly.

Name: the_bazaar__Currency_Exchange
Behaviour: Credits, Shards and Tokens (Part II 38). Rates move with player activity.

Name: the_bazaar__Furniture_Row
Behaviour: Trailer decor. The healthiest thing in the shop.

Name: the_bazaar__The_Auction_Board
Behaviour: Player-listed rare items on a timer.

Name: the_bazaar__Weapon_Tinker
Behaviour: Applies upgrade paths to weapons you already own (Part II 37).

Name: the_bazaar__Potion_Row
Behaviour: All five potions, marked up. Cheaper to brew them yourself.

Name: the_bazaar__The_Empty_Stall
Behaviour: Any player can claim it for an hour and sell their own finds from it.

Name: the_bazaar__Rumour_Table
Behaviour: NPCs repeat things players have actually done in other realities.

Name: the_bazaar__The_Locked_Case
Behaviour: Contains something nobody in the market will name.
Secret: Opens to whoever brings the Eye of Reality here. Do not sell it.

Name: the_bazaar__Lantern_Line
Behaviour: Lighting the whole street opens the night market.
